findings.explanation: test_parts_sum_to_total only checks if the result is a list (assertIsInstance), not that the parts actually sum to the total. Should verify sum(result) == total.

test_parts_differ_by_at_most_one_larger_first only checks the length (len == 3), not that parts differ by at most one cent or that larger parts come first. Should verify max(result) - min(result) <= 1 and result[0] >= result[1].
test_single_part only checks truthiness, not the actual behavior. Should verify that split_evenly(50, 1) returns [50].
